title: Mangaldai Buranji
author: Dineshwar Sarma
genre: Regional History & Administrative Chronicle of Darrang Frontier
description: Exhaustive regional chronicle published by the Assam Publication Board (Asam Prakasan Parisad) documenting the history, administration, Koch royal lineages, Ahom defense lines along the Brahmaputra, temple architecture, and folk traditions of Mangaldai and the Darrang district of Assam.
